question: Should ClawHub land a no-case-colliding package-file rule for SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md while preserving lowercase/legacy aliases?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but the PR changes the public package contract and includes PROTOCOL.md enforcement while current docs/specs still only define the accepted skill readme aliases.

options.title: Document and prove strict collision gate
options.body: Require a rebase against current staged publish code, docs/spec updates for the package rule, and real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break as code-only
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the stricter failures without additional contract documentation, but support and import behavior may surprise affected users.

options.title: Narrow the package scope
options.body: Revise the PR if maintainers only want this enforcement for accepted skill readme aliases and not PROTOCOL.md.

recommendation.title: Document and prove strict collision gate
recommendation.body: Require a rebase against current staged publish code, docs/spec updates for the package rule, and real browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current package contract and staged publish refactor that this PR must integrate with.
